verdict.rationale: Adyen documents how to integrate online card payments, including a single /sessions request, a test environment, and no setup fees. Nothing in the pack documents self-serve signup or how quickly a new account can go live, so the story's 'within a day of signing up' element has no first-party support. Community reports that Adyen turns away small clients and that integration can be complex point the other way, so there is no basis even for partial credit.
